summary: Add the fractal-chatgpt adapter binary and keep st-chatgpt as an alias binary

replay.detail: No graph replay or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The package builds binary fractal-chatgpt (st-chatgpt kept as an alias binary). Both targets compile the same source. Nix package names and lane inputs are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: Source builds can select --bin fractal-chatgpt. Existing --bin st-chatgpt builds and the current Nix package continue to produce the alias binary.

recovery.detail: No persistent data is changed. The alias binary continues to invoke the same adapter.
